installs.label: Installs
installs.definition: Number of new Rapido app installations in the reporting period. An installation does not necessarily represent a new customer: an existing customer can uninstall and reinstall the app.
caveats: Counts app installations, not unique lifetime people.
Do not manufacture monthly distincts by summing shorter-period or channel distinct counts.
Not a city-level absolute metric: do not rank, shortlist, or compare cities on install counts. Use city installs only directionally, to describe organic-versus-paid movement.
city_not_found is unattributed geography (no usable location), not a city or a T3 city; it is excluded from tier and city-level results and included only in national/overall totals.

registrations.label: Registrations
registrations.definition: Number of customers completing their first registration with Rapido in the reporting period. A customer registers only once; reinstalling the app or logging back in does not create another registration.
caveats: Not AppsFlyer af_reg.
Current month-scoped extraction ranks records within the selected month and does not by itself prove lifetime-first registration or legacy export parity.
city_not_found is unattributed geography (no usable location), not a city or a T3 city; it is excluded from tier and city-level results and included only in national/overall totals.

platform_ftu.label: Platform FTU
platform_ftu.definition: Number of customers completing their first-ever Rapido ride in the reporting period. A completed ride has dropped status. A customer becomes a Platform FTU only once, regardless of service.
caveats: Counted independently across services; not the sum of Bike/Link, Auto, and Cab PFTU counts.
Distinct from SFTU, where an existing customer tries another Rapido service for the first time.
Source platform-new flagging is not independently verified first-dropped-ride proof unless separately certified.

platform_link_ftu.label: Bike/Link PFTU
platform_link_ftu.definition: Number of customers whose first-ever completed Rapido ride in the reporting period was on the Bike/Link (`link`) service.
caveats: Measures first-ever Rapido ride on Bike/Link (PFTU), not Bike/Link SFTU.
Bike/Link is measured as the single `link` service category under DEC-023, replacing the earlier seven-service membership; the physical source mapping remains uncertified.

platform_auto_ftu.label: Auto PFTU
platform_auto_ftu.definition: Number of customers whose first-ever completed Rapido ride in the reporting period was on Auto.
caveats: Measures first-ever Rapido ride on Auto (PFTU), not Auto SFTU from existing Bike or Cab customers.

platform_cab_ftu.label: Cab PFTU
platform_cab_ftu.definition: Number of customers whose first-ever completed Rapido ride in the reporting period was on Cab. Cab excludes c2c.
caveats: Measures first-ever Rapido ride on Cab (PFTU), not Cab SFTU from existing Bike or Auto customers.
Excludes c2c, while unselected services still count in independent Platform FTU when platform-new.

fe_sessions.label: Fare Estimate Sessions
fe_sessions.definition: Fare estimate (FE): when the pickup and drop locations are punched in and prices of all service categories are shown. Stored as the monthly city sum of daily customer maximum unique FE sessions across the FTU-eligible cohort (days on or before each customer's lifetime first completed platform ride, plus Zero-Transaction customers with no completed ride yet).
caveats: Counts FTU-eligible FE sessions (not distinct FE users, and excludes repeat-rider days after a customer's first completed platform ride).
Historical months before funnel backfill may have null city rows; nulls remain unavailable, never zero.

rr.label: Rapido Requests
rr.definition: Request Rapido (RR): selecting a service and requesting a ride. Stored as the monthly city sum of daily unique request sessions across the FTU-eligible cohort and all RF service rows.
caveats: Covers the FTU-eligible cohort (on/before first completed platform ride plus Zero-Transaction customers) across all RF service rows (including services outside Bike, Auto, and Cab).
Historical months before funnel backfill may have null city rows; nulls remain unavailable, never zero.

net.label: Net Rides
net.definition: Completed (dropped) orders across the FTU-eligible cohort and all RF service rows in the reporting period.
caveats: Counts FTU-eligible completed rides (including same-day subsequent rides on the customer's first-ride day), distinct from Platform FTU (unique first-ever ride customers).
Covers all RF service rows (including services outside Bike, Auto, and Cab).

bike_rr.label: Bike RR
bike_rr.definition: Monthly city sum of daily unique Rapido Request (RR) sessions across the approved Bike service family for the FTU-eligible cohort.
caveats: Covers the FTU-eligible cohort across the six approved Bike service aliases including Bike Rated by Women and Bike Lite.

bike_net.label: Bike Net Rides
bike_net.definition: Monthly city sum of completed (dropped) orders across the approved Bike service family for the FTU-eligible cohort.
caveats: Covers the FTU-eligible cohort across the six approved Bike service aliases including Bike Rated by Women and Bike Lite.

auto_rr.label: Auto RR
auto_rr.definition: Monthly city sum of daily unique Rapido Request (RR) sessions across the approved Auto service family for the FTU-eligible cohort.
caveats: Covers the FTU-eligible cohort across the approved Auto service variants.

auto_net.label: Auto Net Rides
auto_net.definition: Monthly city sum of completed (dropped) orders across the approved Auto service family for the FTU-eligible cohort.
caveats: Covers the FTU-eligible cohort across the approved Auto service variants.

cab_rr.label: Cab RR
cab_rr.definition: Monthly city sum of daily unique Rapido Request (RR) sessions across the approved Cab service family for the FTU-eligible cohort.
caveats: Covers the FTU-eligible cohort across the approved Cab service variants and excludes c2c.

cab_net.label: Cab Net Rides
cab_net.definition: Monthly city sum of completed (dropped) orders across the approved Cab service family for the FTU-eligible cohort.
caveats: Covers the FTU-eligible cohort across the approved Cab service variants and excludes c2c.

i2r.label: Install-to-Registration Ratio
i2r.definition: Registrations relative to app installations in the same reporting period.
caveats: Compares period totals, not a matched install cohort; do not cap at 100%.
Aggregate approved counts before dividing; never average city ratios.
Not a city-level metric: do not compute or report I2R per city, because installs are unreliable as a city-level absolute. National and aggregate scopes only.

r2n.label: Registration-to-PFTU Ratio
r2n.definition: Customers becoming Platform FTUs relative to registrations in the same reporting period.
caveats: Compares period totals, not a matched registration cohort; customers who registered in earlier months can become Platform FTUs this month, so values can exceed 100%.
Distinct from RR2Net (ride-request fulfilment to dropped rides).
Aggregate approved counts before dividing; never average city ratios.

link_share.label: Bike/Link PFTU Share
link_share.definition: Bike/Link PFTUs relative to all Platform FTUs in the reporting period.
caveats: Reported Bike/Link, Auto, and Cab PFTU shares need not sum to 100%.
Inherits Bike/Link PFTU provenance and proxy caveats for the underlying month.

auto_share.label: Auto PFTU Share
auto_share.definition: Auto PFTUs relative to all Platform FTUs in the reporting period.
caveats: Reported Bike/Link, Auto, and Cab PFTU shares need not sum to 100%.

cab_share.label: Cab PFTU Share
cab_share.definition: Cab PFTUs relative to all Platform FTUs in the reporting period.
caveats: Reported Bike/Link, Auto, and Cab PFTU shares need not sum to 100%; Cab excludes c2c.

fe2rr.label: FE-to-RR Ratio
fe2rr.definition: Demand metric: how many Fare Estimates (FE) translate into Request Rapido (RR) sessions after checking the price.
caveats: Computed from FTU-eligible RR and FE sessions (on/before first completed platform ride plus Zero-Transaction customers).
Aggregate approved counts before dividing; never average city ratios.

rr2net.label: RR-to-Net Ratio
rr2net.definition: Fulfillment metric: how many Rapido Requests (RR) are actually fulfilled and translate into a dropped order (Net ride).
caveats: Computed from FTU-eligible Net rides and RR sessions; distinct from R2N (Registration-to-PFTU).
Aggregate approved counts before dividing; never average city ratios.

bike_rr2net.label: Bike RR-to-Net Ratio
bike_rr2net.definition: Bike fulfillment metric: share of Bike Rapido Requests (RR) fulfilled into dropped Bike orders across the FTU-eligible cohort.
caveats: Uses the six approved Bike service aliases for both Bike RR and Bike Net; aggregate counts before dividing.

auto_rr2net.label: Auto RR-to-Net Ratio
auto_rr2net.definition: Auto fulfillment metric: share of Auto Rapido Requests (RR) fulfilled into dropped Auto orders across the FTU-eligible cohort.
caveats: Uses the approved Auto service family for both Auto RR and Auto Net; aggregate counts before dividing.

cab_rr2net.label: Cab RR-to-Net Ratio
cab_rr2net.definition: Cab fulfillment metric: share of Cab Rapido Requests (RR) fulfilled into dropped Cab orders across the FTU-eligible cohort.
caveats: Uses the approved Cab service family (excluding c2c) for both Cab RR and Cab Net; aggregate counts before dividing.

absolute_delta.label: Absolute Change
absolute_delta.definition: Period-over-period difference in a count metric (latest count minus previous count).

growth_fraction.label: Volume Growth
growth_fraction.definition: Relative change in a count metric over the previous period count; unavailable when either operand is missing or the previous count is zero.

delta_pp.label: Ratio Movement
delta_pp.definition: Signed percentage-point difference between the latest and previous fractional ratios (for example, 40% to 45% is +5pp, not +5%).

link_vs_auto_share_gap.label: Bike-Auto Share Gap
link_vs_auto_share_gap.definition: Difference between Bike/Link PFTU share and Auto PFTU share in the same period; period movement is 100 * (latest gap - previous gap) in percentage points.

platform_ftu_target.label: Platform FTU Target
platform_ftu_target.definition: Planned number of Platform FTU (first-ever completed rides) for a month, supplied by the city-level target plan. The plan carries a national Grand Total, per-city targets and a New launch fallback; these are planning inputs, not observed actuals or commitments.

grand_total.label: Grand Total
grand_total.definition: Authoritative overall target for the month. It is independent of the summed city targets and is not reconciled to them; the pooled New launch fallback never changes it.

city_target.label: City target
city_target.definition: Planned target for one canonical city. Attingal and Trivandrum targets are combined under Trivandrum; Ludhiana keeps its T2-source target while its observed tier is unchanged.

new_launch_fallback.label: New launch fallback
new_launch_fallback.definition: Single planning target for all observed cities absent from the plan, compared against their combined observed Platform FTU. It is not an allocation, per-city target, shared budget or launch evidence; explicit missing or nonpositive city targets do not join the pool.

target_variance.label: Target Variance
target_variance.definition: Signed difference between observed Platform FTU and an assigned target, for a matched city or the pooled New launch group. A negative variance is a target miss (shortfall) and a positive variance is above target (overshoot); missing operands make it unavailable, never zero.

variance_percentage.label: Variance Percentage
variance_percentage.definition: Signed variance relative to the assigned positive target (a city's target or the pooled New launch target), displayed as a percentage. Negative means below target and positive means above target. It is unavailable for missing operands or a nonpositive target, while the valid absolute variance remains available.

target_shortlist.label: Material Target Miss Shortlist
target_shortlist.definition: Policy-based list of cities whose own target miss is material. Arithmetic and ordering come from reviewed tools; this is not a severity, forecast or causal claim.
target_shortlist.eligibility: Strictly more than 5% below the city's own positive target (variance < -5%); exactly -5% and smaller misses are excluded, and missing operands or nonpositive targets cannot qualify.
target_shortlist.ordering: Ranked by largest negative Platform FTU variance (largest shortfall) first, then city name.
target_shortlist.coverage_selection: Top mode selects in that order until cumulative shortfall covered reaches X = max(overall target - observed actual, 0); all mode returns every qualifying city even when X is zero. The threshold is never relaxed.
target_shortlist.match_queue: Default plan-matched queue: cities with an explicit city target in the plan, selected and ranked on their own.
target_shortlist.fallback_queue: Unplanned cities are excluded from the default queue and returned only on explicit request as one pooled comparison of their non-null Platform FTU sum against the single New launch target, with an actual-only per-city breakdown. Every unplanned city has no individual target or variance.
target_shortlist.tier_scope: For a tier, the target, actual and gap use only plan-matched cohort cities; unplanned cities stay outside that tier calculation and are reported separately as the national New launch pool. National Grand Total reporting is unchanged.

target_persistence.label: Target Miss Widening Against Prior Month
target_persistence.definition: Annotation of a currently returned material target miss whose variance percentage also worsened against the immediately previous stored month. Each row is labelled persistent or new_miss.
target_persistence.eligibility: A currently returned plan-matched city must be strictly more than 5% below its own positive target (variance < -5%) in the selected month, and the immediately previous calendar month must have an explicit positive city target and a non-null actual. The same -5% rule labels the row; a prior-month material miss is not required.
target_persistence.comparison: Listed only when current variance percentage minus previous variance percentage is strictly less than -5 percentage points (worsened by >5pp), evaluated with exact integer arithmetic before display rounding.
target_persistence.statuses: persistent when the prior variance was also strictly less than -5% of its positive target, otherwise new_miss. failing_since is the previous month for persistent rows and the selected month for new_miss rows.
target_persistence.scope: Only currently returned page cities with an explicit plan city target are checked; pooled New launch fallback cities have no individual target and are never annotated.
target_persistence.tier_scope: The selected month's stored tier is the only tier source; the prior month's tier is not required to match.
target_persistence.limits: A city that missed both months but improved is not listed. The list is not only persistent misses: new_miss rows were not a material miss in the prior month. Absence is not evidence that a city met earlier targets or that the prior month was complete.

sftu.definition: An existing customer taking a particular Rapido service for the first time after completing earlier rides on another Rapido service. GrowthOS V1 service breakdowns measure service PFTU (first-ever Rapido ride), not SFTU.

rules.reporting_period: Completed Asia/Kolkata calendar months plus, at most, the current month to date; CLI output month_to_date.basis says how a month-to-date month was used. Adjacent months are MoM; nonadjacent pairs are period comparisons.
rules.missing_and_zero_values: Missing city-month observations or operands remain null (unavailable), never zero. Zero denominators or zero baselines make ratios or growth unavailable while valid absolute deltas remain available.
rules.aggregation: Sum approved counts across complete cohorts before dividing ratios; never average city ratios or sum monthly unique counts into multi-month distinct totals. Incomplete cohort totals stay null alongside labeled known_subtotal values.
rules.interpretation: Arithmetic and funnel movements describe observations, not proven marketing, CRM, pricing, or supply causality. Stored month_metadata governs actual extraction provenance.
